descriptionMarkdown:
This is an updated version of an older blueprint.

It crafts everything that is available on Nauvis except for science packs (over 170 different items in total)

Including belts, inserters, bots, ammunition, etc...

Constructive critique is appreciated ;-)

Input:

        135 iron ore per sec     
        90 copper ore per sec
        45 stone per sec
        30 coal per sec
        45 uranium ore per sec
        320 oil per sec
        water
Edits:

I realised that it might be difficult to build that thing in one go especially in a new playthrough so I made a book that is more beginner friendly^^. Just overlay the blueprints while you progress. 

I highly recommend to force stamp  (Control/Shift/Left Click) the blueprints on top of each other after you align them. It changes quite a bit with each layer and that should make it easier to upgrade.

If you have problems with mixed pipes, place the pipes first and the refineries second, that should resolve it.

A few issues fixed especially with the uranium production, everything should work properly now. 
If someone finds an issue let me know.

Electric furnaces and modules are now included in higher layers.

Space age machines are now included in the highest layer.
title: Everything you need for Nauvis (Space Age Mall crafts over 170 items from ores to endproduct)
